item: V1. Huaneng Cangnan 4: foundation types (dlztb O&M tender)
proposal:
F5('CHN', 'Huaneng Cangnan 4', 'mx', url='http://www.dlztb.com/chinapowerbid/202509/113770.html', parts=[['mp', 42], ['pc', 35]],
   zh='77 部 5.2 MW：華能浙江公司 2025-09 為已建成風場招標的單樁基礎固化土沖刷防護工程寫明風機基礎共 77 座，42 座單樁、35 座承台（本次只做 42 座單樁）；承台由 6 根鋼管樁支撐（首座承台 2021-03，世紀新能源網），即高樁承台；溫州海事局 2025-12 通告已建成投用。',
   en='77 × 5.2 MW: Huaneng Zhejiang’s Sept 2025 tender for scour protection at the built farm states the 77 turbine foundations are 42 monopiles and 35 pile caps (the job covers the 42 monopiles); each cap stands on six steel piles (first cap, Mar 2021, ne21), i.e. high-rise pile caps; Wenzhou MSA notice (Dec 2025): built and in service.'),
D('CHN', 'Huaneng Cangnan 4', depth=(26, 34), url='https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=adec97d82c014ec5922be0b6627b9baa', zh='溫州海事局 2025-12 通航要素通告（已建成投用）：水深約 26–34 m，77 台 5.2 MW。', en='Wenzhou MSA notice (Dec 2025, built and in service): depth about 26–34 m, 77 × 5.2 MW.')
note_zh: 2025-09 的單樁沖刷防護招標（電力招標採購網轉載，大唐電商平台頻道）是建成後的運維工程，寫明 77 座基礎＝42 座單樁＋35 座承台；與 2021 年首座承台 6 根樁、2022 年單樁最重 2400 噸的報導一致（原規劃 466 根樁＝全部承台，後改為混合）。D 列沿用第 14 輪已核對的海事局數字。
note_en: The Sept 2025 monopile scour-protection tender (reposted by dlztb) is post-construction work and states 77 foundations = 42 monopiles + 35 pile caps; consistent with the six-pile first cap (2021) and 2,400 t monopiles (2022) reported earlier (the original plan of 466 piles was all caps). The D row reuses the MSA figures checked in round 14.
why: Tender is for scour protection of the existing monopiles ('保护已建风机、基础等海上构筑物'), i.e. after construction; foundation count matches the 77 turbines in the MSA as-built notice.

本次招标内容主要为42台单桩基础的固化土冲刷防护施工、基础扫测，海缆及弯曲限制器扫测或探摸。

因华能苍南4号海上风电项目已建成投用
水深约26米～34米
工程安装77台5.2兆瓦风电机组

item: V2a. CGN Shanwei Jiazi I: turbine field (data check)
proposal:
fix('CHN', 'CGN Shanwei Jiazi I', C,
    '甲子一 78 部明陽 6.45 MW（中國電力網 2022-04：擬安裝 78 台 MySE6.45MW、首台 6.45 MW 已裝；汕尾海事局 2025-08 備案參數：78 台 6.45 MW）。海事局備案的葉輪直徑為 168 m、輪轂高 100 m，與原寫的 MySE6.45-180（葉輪約 178–180 m）不合，型號尾碼沒有出處，改為只寫 6.45 MW（確切型號待查證）',
    'Jiazi I has 78 Mingyang 6.45 MW turbines (China Power, Apr 2022: 78 MySE6.45MW planned, first 6.45 MW unit erected; Shanwei MSA filed parameters, Aug 2025: 78 × 6.45 MW). The MSA filing gives a 168 m rotor and 100 m hub, which does not fit the stored MySE6.45-180 (a 178–180 m rotor); the suffix had no source, so only the 6.45 MW rating is kept (exact model unverified)',
    'https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=255290a5a1bf454781d9520088a87167', turbine='78x Mingyang MySE 6.45 MW'),
note_zh: 沒有找到任何寫明 MySE6.45-180 用於甲子一的出處；明陽 6.45 MW 有 -175、-180 等不同葉輪版本（勒門 I 為 MySE6.45-175），海事局的 168 m 是建成後備案值。暫不寫成 -168（查不到這個型號名）。
note_en: No source ties MySE6.45-180 to Jiazi I; Mingyang's 6.45 MW comes in several rotor versions (-175 at Lemen I, -180), and the MSA's 168 m is a post-completion filing. Not written as '-168' because no such model name could be found.
why: The record's '-180' suffix is unsupported and contradicts the MSA as-built rotor; chinapower confirms the Mingyang MySE 6.45 MW platform.

item: V2b. CGN Shanwei Jiazi I: foundation types
proposal: No F5 row. Design 70 monopiles + 8 four-pile jackets (cpem, plan); construction lots: I = 30 monopiles (dlztb 2019-12), II = 41 monopiles + 43 turbine installs (ne21) → 71 monopiles, 7 others unaccounted. D row (round 14) stays ready.
note_zh: 中廣核 2025-12 甲子一、二零星消缺招標（已建成投產）寫有「風電機組單樁基礎防腐處理」，證實有單樁，但沒有分項數量；海事局 2025-08 備案通告附「平面布置圖（竣工圖）」PDF 是掃描圖，無文字可核對；附件 1 風機座標清單沒有基礎欄。
note_en: CGN's Dec 2025 defect-rectification tender for the built Jiazi I and II mentions 'monopile foundation anti-corrosion' of the turbines, confirming monopiles but giving no counts; the MSA Aug 2025 filing's as-built layout PDF is a scanned image (not quotable) and its coordinate list has no foundation column.
why: dlztb site search only indexes items from about mid-2025 on; ecp.cgnpc.com.cn search API not found (homepage TLS reset); shanwei.gov.cn has no Jiazi I post-construction sea-use report (searched natural-resources notices 2025–2026).

item: V5. Zhuhai Guishan: as-built capacity, turbine mix, foundations (data check)
proposal: No change yet. Leave the existing rule (198 MW, 2021); candidate later edit: note that two further units on composite-bucket foundations were added after 2021 (first bucket installed 26 Jun 2022; bucket EPC works extended to 30 Dec 2024; MSA July 2025: 49 turbines, 200 MW). Foundation row: mx (phase-1 four-pile jackets, later monopiles, 2 composite buckets) once counts are found.
note_zh: 廣州海事局 2025-07 已完工備案：建成 200 MW、49 台（座標表 1#–49#，38# 座標精度不同、位於筒型基礎施工水域內，應是後加的）。長江設計集團「筒型基礎專項 EPC」2022-06-26 裝好第一座圓形筒型基礎、第二座為多邊形；海事局 2024 年通告施工延到 2024-12-30；中文維基寫 2024 年在二期範圍加建兩台。所以 2021-12「全容量併網、198 MW」是加建前的狀態，200 MW 與 198 MW 的差異（及各期機型）仍無法以可核對的出處定案（2021 年一期後續及二期 13 台機型的報導在 in-en.com，連不上）。
note_en: Guangzhou MSA completion filing (Jul 2025): built 200 MW with 49 turbines (coordinate list 1#–49#; 38# has different precision and lies in the bucket works area, so it was added later). CJWSJY's bucket-foundation special EPC installed the first circular bucket on 26 Jun 2022, with a second, polygonal one to follow; an MSA notice extended the works to 30 Dec 2024, and zh.wikipedia says two turbines were added in phase 2 in 2024. The Dec 2021 '198 MW, full connection' therefore predates these units; the 200 vs 198 MW difference and the per-phase models still cannot be settled from checkable sources (the 2021 report on the 13 phase-2 units is on in-en.com, unreachable).
why: yanshougs.com lists Guishan's soil-and-water acceptance (Nov 2023) but its PDFs are Cloudflare-blocked (403); Southern Offshore Wind has no public procurement site found.
